title: Support Orchestration Toolkit and Idempotent Scenario Runner
creator: Priya Raman
description: Create a lightweight Support Orchestration Toolkit (SOT) that compiles existing runbooks into idempotent, checkpointed tasks with a safe simulation/playback mode for on-call rehearsals. Motivations: reduce manual error during incidents, make remediation steps reproducible and reversible when possible, and provide operators with a guided interface that enforces preconditions (RBAC, approvals, dry-run). The toolkit will produce task graphs from authored YAML runbooks, attach telemetry hooks at step boundaries, and expose a 'play mode' for non-destructive validation. It must be compatible with opsctl and the admin-agent sidecar, and integrate with existing observability dashboards and our Telemetry Action Suggester prototype.
acceptance_criteria: SOT can import 90% of canonical incident runbooks (format: runbook-v2 YAML) and generate a DAG of steps with explicit inputs/outputs
Each step supports: dry-run, execute, rollback (where provided), and idempotency markers (safe/retryable/non-repeatable)
Play mode executes a runbook in non-destructive simulation and produces a diffable execution trace identical in structure to a real run (minus external side effects)
Operators can trigger a partially-executed runbook from a saved checkpoint and continue/resume without duplicating side effects
SOT emits structured telemetry events for: step:start, step:end, step:error, checksum-of-state, and operator-action with tags for ticket/route/model
End-to-end e2e test harness validates at least 5 representative incident scenarios (deploy failure, KV cache corruption, routing fallback, quota exhaustion, dedicated node OOM) in CI
Rollout gated behind security review and RBAC integration tests; no admin-level operations permitted without explicit approval flow
Docs and a training playbook exist: Confluence guide + 2 recorded sessions for oncall team
design_notes: Primary runtime: compile runbook-v2 YAML -> intermediate task graph (flat list with dependencies) -> execution engine (idempotent step runner)
Idempotency model: three-tier tags: 'retryable' (safe to re-run), 'checkpointed' (requires resume semantics), 'side-effect' (requires guard/approval)
Checkpoint store: use existing Admin Ledger service to persist step checkpoints and operator decisions (leverages ENG-853210 work on ledgers)
Simulation uses a mock adapter for external APIs (DNS, cloud APIs, infra controlplane) that records intended calls and returns canned responses; must be configurable per-customer
Safety: any step tagged 'side-effect' requires either a pre-approved signature or an in-flow 2-step approval via console/Slack
Execution isolation: runbooks execute in ephemeral pods in dedicated namespace with network egress controls; secrets surfaced via short-lived KMS tokens
Telemetry schema: follow 'support.action.v1' event format used by ENG-517200 telemetry action suggester; include correlation_id and runbook_id
implementation_plan: Week 1: define runbook-v2 schema extensions and produce a canonical converter for existing runbooks -> PR (owner: Marcus)
Week 2: implement intermediate task graph compiler + unit tests (owner: Jorge)
Week 3: build step runner with idempotency markers, dry-run behavior, checkpoint persistence to Admin Ledger (owner: Li)
Week 4: integrate simulation adapter and play-mode UI hooks; add e2e harness scenarios (owner: Aisha)
Week 5: telemetry events wired to observability pipeline and dashboards; implement approvals flow with SSO (owner: Marcus)
Week 6: security review, RBAC matrix tests, performance tuning; prepare rollout doc and training materials (owner: Priya)
Final: create migration job to convert top 50 production runbooks and schedule canary with oncall team
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal SRE + 2 oncall champions run 10 non-critical scenarios in play mode for 2 weeks
Canary: enable SOT for low-risk incidents in a single team (infra-services) with 'audit-only' mode for 1 sprint
Gradual: after successful canary, enable execute mode with 24/7 oncall coverage and rollback runbooks available
Full: migrate top 50 runbooks, enable default play-mode in console and add training to new-hire oncall checklist
Fallback: automatic revert to original shell scripts and alerts if more than 3 critical failures in 72 hours
telemetry_and_observability: Emit structured support.action.v1 events to Kafka topic 'support.actions' with runbook_id, step_id, operator, outcome
Dashboards: Grafana panel - 'SOT: active runs / success rate / mean time per step' (link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/support-sot)
Alerting: SLO on runbook execution success >= 95% for non-side-effect flows; alert if step retry rate > 10%
Trace context: attach X-Request-ID and model-route to each step for downstream performance attribution
testing_plan: Unit tests for compiler, idempotency markers, and checkpoint restore/merge behavior
Integration tests using mocked adapters for cloud APIs and real Admin Ledger (staging)
CI e2e matrix: run 5 scenarios across supported runtimes (hosted, dedicated, private) on PRs
Chaos tests: simulate partial network failures and ensure resume semantics hold
Manual tabletop exercises with SRE + Support to validate approval flows and training materials
